error_attribution: The pre-cutoff system gave too much weight to elevated U.S. yields as a source of overnight USDJPY support.
Post-ISM yields rose, but USDJPY did not sustain the 158.30 area, showing that the rate channel alone was insufficient.
Lower oil reduced a yen-negative terms-of-trade force during the night.
Intervention sensitivity and Japan-side support may have contributed, but this remains interpretation rather than a proven causal attribution.
The forecast was deliberately low-confidence at p_up=0.53; the miss, if confirmed with qualified data, would be small-probability calibration evidence rather than a large conviction failure.
lessons_for_challenger_only: Track divergence between U.S. yield changes and USDJPY response explicitly.
Do not assume rising Treasury yields translate one-for-one into USDJPY upside when intervention sensitivity is elevated.
Do not modify the current frozen-candidate specification from this single exploratory observation.
next_action: Keep the original forecast and this evaluation immutable; obtain a qualified reference-feed route before any formal scored cohort.
